Under Settings → Android and device, optionally enable Live Updates and the experimental HyperIsland client. It is off by default. Android 16 supplies a system chronometer to supporting builds; HyperOS 3 gets a separate time-and-controls template without project names. Xiaomi requires app approval, which OTM has not obtained. A dismissed session is not promoted again. Unsupported systems retain the ordinary notification. OEM device rendering is unverified.

Android 12+: device colors and responsive widgets. Android 13+: app language and a system tile-add dialog. Android 15–16: edge-to-edge layouts and adaptive screens. Availability also depends on the launcher and manufacturer.

Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO: HyperIsland uses the documented HyperOS 3 client template but depends on Xiaomi approval, model and region. Protocol support does not confirm app permission. MIUI and earlier HyperOS retain the ordinary notification. If controls stop updating, review this app’s Notifications and Battery settings; change only what is necessary.

Samsung / One UI: if controls stop updating, check the app’s battery settings and whether it was put in Sleeping or Deep sleeping apps. Keep normal battery protection unless there is a specific problem.

OPPO / OnePlus / realme: ColorOS, OxygenOS and realme UI can limit background activity or autolaunch. If controls stop updating, review the app’s battery and notification settings. Names and availability vary by version.

Your manufacturer may add background or notification restrictions. If controls stop updating, review this app’s system settings. Menu names vary; no blanket battery-optimization exemption is required.
